run_copyright_check: run the copyright checker script to validate license headers in all git-tracked source files
run_copyright_check_precommit: run the copyright checker in precommit mode to check only modified files in the current git working tree
run_copyright_check_list_output: run the copyright checker with list output mode to print only filenames without details
run_copyright_check_show_skips: run the copyright checker with skips enabled to log files that were skipped during the check
review_LICENSE_PREFIX: review the LICENSE_PREFIX dictionary that maps file extensions to their comment-style regex patterns for license validation
